trials.claim: Tier 1 limited to 0 hourly and 10 daily and 10 mini apps per month automations
trials.claimQuote: 0 Hourly & 10 daily. & 10 Mini apps per month Automations
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict the Tier 1 limits.

trials.claim: Automate any spreadsheet task with AI using plain English without formulas or coding
trials.claimQuote: Automate any spreadsheet task with AI using plain English—no formulas or coding required
trials.reasoning: The vendor states complex tasks are simplified using plain English commands, and a buyer says it facilitates anything they can think of doing with spreadsheets. A learning curve or tutorials do not show formulas or coding are required.

exhibits.quote: One thing to note is that there will be a learning curve.
exhibits.argument: A learning curve contradicts the claim that any task can be automated with plain English and no formulas or coding.

exhibits.quote: You need to take your time to watch the tutorial videos and read the docs to figure out the commands and API setups.
exhibits.argument: Requiring tutorial videos, docs, commands and API setups undermines the claim of effortless plain-English automation without coding.

exhibits.quote: Simplify complex tasks by using plain English commands.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states tasks are done with plain English commands, supporting no-formula operation.

exhibits.quote: to have an assistant that will tremendously facilitate anything you can think of doing with spreadsheets.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool facilitates anything the user can think of in spreadsheets.

trials.claim: Automate all spreadsheet tasks with a single plain English command
trials.claimQuote: Managing your business in spreadsheets works...until spreadsheets start managing you. Good thing SheetXAI lets you automate all your spreadsheet tasks with a single command in plain English.
trials.reasoning: Reviews report sheets becoming corrupted when combining operations and unstable Google Sheets integration requiring frequent reloads. This materially limits the claim that all spreadsheet tasks can be automated with a single command.

exhibits.quote: When combining structural operations (delete + rename + split), the sheet becomes corrupted.
exhibits.argument: Corruption when combining operations contradicts the claim that all tasks can be automated with a single command.

exhibits.quote: The integration with Google Sheets has been unstable, requiring frequent reloads to function properly.
exhibits.argument: Instability requiring frequent reloads undermines the claim that all spreadsheet tasks work with a single plain English command.

trials.claim: Execute multi-step operations like cleaning data, splitting columns, removing blanks, fixing formatting, and generating reports
trials.claimQuote: Execute multi-step operations instantly, like cleaning data, splitting columns, removing blanks, fixing formatting, and generating reports
trials.reasoning: Reviews report inconsistent results on multi-column structural edits and different structural outcomes from the same prompt run multiple times. This materially limits the claim of reliably executing multi-step operations, despite other reviews reporting successful examples.

exhibits.quote: Multi-column structural edits (deleting multiple columns at once) produce inconsistent results.
exhibits.argument: Inconsistent results on multi-column edits directly contradicts the claim of instantly executing multi-step operations like splitting and cleaning.

exhibits.quote: Running the same prompt multiple times produces different structural outcomes.
exhibits.argument: Different outcomes from the same prompt undermines the claim that multi-step operations execute reliably and instantly.

exhibits.quote: It can clean data, research companies, organize information, extract data from documents, create reports, and automate multi-step spreadsheet work using plain English.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms cleaning data, creating reports and automating multi-step work in plain English.

exhibits.quote: I use it to automagically separate and format complex data from a single column into multiple columns across three tabs and over 300 lines.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms splitting a single column into multiple columns with formatting.
